source.title: A phase II clinical trial does not show that high dose simvastatin has beneficial effect on markers of bone turnover in multiple myeloma.

scope: Inspect clinical simvastatin bone-turnover study, actual phaseII design, disease/treatment status, comparator/control timing, N and missing/evaluable counts, dose/schedule/cointerventions, exact bone-marker and other outcomes with units/time/uncertainty, null/safety findings. Do not turn bone-marker changes into fractures, tumor control or clinical survival; no assumption of randomizeddesign, equivalence or safe highdose.
